categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds unit tests across four script test suites (script_segwit_tests, script_tests, sigopcount_tests, script_standard_tests) covering edge cases in src/script/script.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage for untested boundary conditions and synthetic mutants in core consensus script functions. The PR exercises CScript::IsPayToTaproot(), CScript::IsPayToAnchor(), CScript::GetSigOpCount(), CScript::HasValidOps(), CScriptWitness::ToString(), and CScript::GetOp() to kill 12 live mutants documented in the PR description. While covering high-risk consensus code paths offers real value, targeting synthetic mutant survival rather than demonstrated realistic regression risks makes the work worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
